doc.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Basie rhythm section and Freddie Green
summary: Eddie Jones, Basie, Sonny Payne and Freddie Green; Green's easygoing temperament.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: What was the basic rhythm section while you were in the group?
Eddie Jones, Bas’, Sonny Payne and Freddie Green.
Freddie was certainly an important part of that.
He was a very easy going type of person. Very level. Of course he could, if he did get upset it was kind of fun to see.
He would wait and choose his moments, huh?
